title: Free energy, surprisal, uncertainty and arousal are one quantity

statements.text: The so-called level of consciousness is a function of variational free energy. Free energy in thermodynamic terms entails entropy, which in information-theoretic terms is surprisal and uncertainty, which in neurophysiological terms is arousal, and arousal underpins wakefulness.

sources.quote: Free energy in thermodynamic terms entails entropy, which in information-theoretic terms is surprisal (and uncertainty), which in neurophysiological terms is arousal
